reply.emotion: energetic and busy, getting things done around the house
notes: Use 'putzen' when cleaning surfaces, rooms, or objects like shoes or teeth. It is more hands-on and physical than just tidying up ('aufräumen').

senses.definition: To clean something by washing, wiping, or scrubbing it to remove dirt.

examples.text: Samstags muss ich das ganze Haus putzen.
examples.translation: On Saturdays I have to clean the whole house.
examples.emotion: burdened and tired, complaining about weekend chores

senses.definition: To clean your teeth using a toothbrush.

examples.text: Vergiss nicht, dir vor dem Schlafen die Zähne zu putzen.
examples.translation: Don't forget to brush your teeth before going to sleep.
examples.emotion: caring and gentle, reminding someone before bed

definitions: To clean something by washing, wiping, or scrubbing it to remove dirt.
To clean your teeth using a toothbrush.
